voice: ElevenLabs "Jerry B." (Motivational & Coaching), Eleven Multilingual v2 - PLACEHOLDER
settings: two long takes (FitBit Game/voice-takes/take1.mp3, take2.mp3) cut at the pauses; lines that could not be placed for certain are left out and play from assets/voice

zoneIn.0.text: In the zone. Hold this pace.

zoneIn.1.text: That's it, you're in. Keep it smooth.

below.0.text: Heart rate's dropping. Pick it up.

below.1.text: Bring it back up. Bigger moves.

coast.0.text: Coast. Light moves, let it rise.

coast.1.text: Ease off and let your heart catch up.

landingPerfect.0.text: Perfect landing. Right in the zone.

landingPerfect.1.text: Nailed it. Right where we wanted.

streak30.0.text: Thirty seconds in the zone. Keep it rolling.

streak60.0.text: One full minute in the zone. Beautiful.

streak120.0.text: Two minutes in the zone. That's the workout.

coolDown.0.text: Cool-down. Slow reaches overhead, and breathe. Four in, six out.

coolDown.1.text: Easy now. Reach up slow, breathe out long.

recovery.0.text: Keep breathing. Let the heart rate come down.

finish.1.text: That's the session. Nice work today.

warmUp.0.text: Warm-up. Easy punches, get the blood moving.

training.0.text: Training starts now. Let's climb to your zone.

below5.0.text: A few beats under. Bigger swings.

below5.1.text: Just under the zone. Punch a little harder.

below5.2.text: A few beats short. Lift the pace a touch.

below10.0.text: About ten under. Use your legs.

below10.1.text: Around ten short. Bend your knees and drive.

below10.2.text: Ten or so under. Get your legs into it.

below15.0.text: Well under. Big moves, build it up.

below15.1.text: A long way under. Go big, whole body.

below15.2.text: Way under the zone. Big swings, deep squats.

above5.0.text: A few beats over. Ease off.

above5.1.text: Just over the zone. Soften it a little.

above10.0.text: Well over. Light hands, long breaths.

above10.1.text: Too high. Slow right down and breathe.

above10.2.text: Way over the zone. Easy hands, breathe out long.

coastHold.0.text: Hold... let it rise... land it.

coastHold.1.text: Wait for it... let it climb... land it.

flick.0.text: Those are flicks. Punch through the target.

flick.1.text: Too light. Drive your fist right through.

flick.2.text: No flicking. Full punches, all the way through.

ghostAhead.0.text: You're ahead of your last run.

ghostAhead.1.text: Ahead of last time. Keep it there.

ghostBehind.0.text: Your last run is ahead. Reel it in.

ghostBehind.1.text: Behind last time. Close the gap.

ghostBehind.2.text: Last time you were ahead here. Catch up.

restart.0.text: Welcome back. Short and easy today.

restart.1.text: Good to see you again. Easy one today.

restart.2.text: Welcome back. We'll keep it light today.

bossArrive.0.text: Guardian day. Break its shield while you're in the zone.

bossArrive.1.text: The Guardian is here. Your hits only count in the zone.

bossExposed.1.text: You're in the zone. It's wide open.

bossGuarded.0.text: Shield's up. Get back in your zone.

bossGuarded.1.text: It's guarded. Climb back to your zone.

bossGuarded.2.text: Shield's back up. Bring your heart rate up.

bossOverheat.0.text: It's overheating. Ease off and breathe.

bossOverheat.1.text: Too hot. Back it down and breathe.

bossBroke.0.text: Shield down! Go for the core.

bossBroke.1.text: The shield is gone! Hit the core.

bossDefeated.1.text: You beat the Guardian! That's the week done.

bossRetreat.0.text: It got away. It'll be back.

bossRetreat.1.text: The Guardian slipped away. It'll be back.

cue.hold-the-shape-both-fists-in-the-rin.text: Hold the shape - both fists in the rings!

cue.knee-drive-grab-the-bar-overhead-pul.text: KNEE DRIVE! Grab the bar overhead, pull it down and drive your knee up

cue.wall-ball-round-squat-drive-up-press.text: WALL BALL ROUND! Squat, drive up, press it to the ring - on the beat, all the way

cue.chop-the-tree-hands-together-by-your.text: CHOP THE TREE! Hands together by your shoulder, swing across through the trunk

cue.tiptoe-reach-up-on-your-toes-and-tou.text: TIPTOE REACH! Up on your toes and touch the star

cue.heavy-bag-hooks-and-uppercuts-hit-th.text: HEAVY BAG! Hooks and uppercuts - hit the lit spot hard

cue.sled-run-copy-the-coach-stand-tall-a.text: SLED RUN! Copy the coach: stand tall, arms up... then squat and push both poles down and back

cue.battle-ropes-pump-both-arms-stay-low.text: BATTLE ROPES! Pump both arms, stay low!

cue.slalom-dip-left-dip-right-quick.text: SLALOM! Dip left, dip right - quick!

cue.duck-and-weave-lean-away-duck-under-.text: DUCK AND WEAVE! Lean away, duck under the row, come up the other side

cue.missiles-lean-or-duck-out-of-the-way.text: MISSILES! Lean or duck out of the way

cue.incoming-guard-up-both-fists-by-your.text: Incoming! GUARD UP - both fists by your chin

cue.guard-both-fists-up-to-your-chin.text: Guard: both fists up to your chin!

cue.phone-went-quiet-estimating-from.text: Phone went quiet - estimating from movement

cue.heart-rate-looks-stuck-check-the-ban.text: Heart rate looks stuck - check the band is snug
